actual.descripcion: Appalachian Vendetta | Once-friendly neighbors on a mountain road become sworn enemies after one family calls police about a theft -- violating the unspoken tradition of leaving authorities out of disputes; years of conflict finally culminate with shots fired.

siguiente.titulo: Fear Thy Neighbor • Other People's Property
siguiente.descripcion: Other People's Property | The mountain road between them fails to keep two long-time neighbors from tormenting each other; seemingly small events bring their decadeslong hostility to a bloody boil, and property lines become battle lines in a fight to the death.

lista.titulo: Caught in the Net • Monsters Are Real
lista.descripcion: Monsters Are Real | After the murder of young mother Morgan Ashley Fox, investigators don't have much physical evidence; with numerous suspects in the frame, digital evidence reveals the secrets of a monster hiding in plain sight.

Fire and Fury | A man holds his child hostage in California; officers negotiate with him, but he sets the house on fire; in Florida, criminals break into a jewelry store; officers must catch them before they escape with over $70,000 worth of jewelry.

lista.titulo: Body Cam • Fight, Flight or Flee
lista.descripcion: Fight, Flight or Flee | In Ohio, cops face a hostage situation with a fugitive willing to go to extremes; in Maryland, police catch armed robbers in the act, and they run from the law; in Indiana, police risk it all to save circus animals inside a burning truck.

Nowhere to Hide | In California, an argument in a bar leads to a hostage situation; in New Mexico, a shoplifter fires upon an officer before going on the run; in Wisconsin, a suspect disappears into the frozen wilderness after flipping his car.
